description: This Java source file defines the final class ModifyAclEntry which represents a command to modify a single ACL entry of a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for the ACL entry and target thing ID. The class is annotated as deprecated and immutable, and it extends a base command class, indicating it is part of a command pattern for managing ACL entries.
